author: PC Gamer
text:
Steve Buscemi joins the Far Cry TV series cast and now we're all wondering: will he be a weird, helpful NPC, or a weirdly charismatic villain?
You never can tell with this guy.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Future Games Show returns to Gamescom with 3 shows
The Gamescom showcases will feature "world premieres, exclusive trailers, developer deep dives and brand-new game demos."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Epic Games Store boss quits after 8 years to take up new role at Saber Interactive
Steve Allison launched Epic's storefront in 2018 and held the reins until earlier this month.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The best Palworld 1.0 base locations for early game builds, resource-rich farms, or raid safe havens
Real estate for new saves, hardwood farming, or a little bit of everything.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen's new region and dungeons sound great, but I'm more excited to finally high-five my Pawn on command
'Tis one of a servant's many privileges.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Hollywood still has time to avoid the gaming industry's disastrous consolidation endgame
It's already bad times in movies & TV, but blocking the Paramount and Warner Bros. merger would stop another disaster in the making.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After releasing a bummer of a Diablo 4 season, Blizzard swoops in with an update that fixes some of its worst issues
Loot is back, everyone!

author: PC Gamer
text:
A forgotten dungeon crawler from the Baldur's Gate era is coming to Steam and GOG for the first time ever
Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor floundered when it was new, but I have to admit that I'm very interested in this re-release.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct returns September 20
We had such a good time last year we decided this should be an annual trip.

author: PC Gamer
text:
George Lucas says rejecting AI is like rejecting cars in favour of horses: 'There's nothing you can do about it… it's the future'
Not sure about that one, George.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I've helped 100 cats mail parcels in Cat Mail Co. which is why I can safely say it's one of the best management sims I've played in a very long time
It's excellent with or without friends.

author: PC Gamer
text:
This DIY 'OpenPuck' project allows the Steam Controller to emulate Xbox, Switch, and PlayStation controllers, but no wireless charging for you
Still, it's a perfectly practical puck in many respects.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ubisoft promises new Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, and Ghost Recon games are coming, but says this year will be 'quieter' than most
Please be patient.

author: PC Gamer
text:
DRAM demand predicted to outstrip supply by 28.7 exabytes in 2030, which is almost as much as the actual DRAM in the world right now
More to come? Joy.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Despite adding an eternal fast travel stone, Dragon's Dogma 2 director maintains you don't have to use it: 'It's just you now have a third option'
I somewhat disagree, even if ox carts were a pain in the rear.

author: PC Gamer
text:
BOE's new $9 billion OLED monitor plant, capable of churning out 10 million panels this year alone, is now up and running—with some big names already on board
That's a whole lot of OLED competition and some seriously delicious pixels.

author: PC Gamer
text:
How to get Ancient Bone in Palworld
Acquire fancy new accessories with this rare material.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I reckon Assassin's Creed Unity is one of the series' best, and a former Ubisoft director agrees it's 'One of the most underestimated games in the series'
Allons enfants de la patrie.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Doom: The Dark Ages – Revelations review
Fixes all my issues with The Dark Ages and injects plenty of Eternal's movement for the best demon-slaying action yet.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The designer of cult classic King of Dragon Pass says his upcoming hellish heist game is pushing the boundaries of a concept he invented in 1999: 'There's really nothing else quite like it'
Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists is a unique enough game that it needed a new genre descriptor.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Worse than our expectations': IBM's shares drop 25% after CEO says it hasn't adapted quickly enough to AI industry changes
That's a steep drop.

author: PC Gamer
text:
WoW devs are 'looking into' an annoying grappling hook that takes a spot on your action bar, despite only being used in one zone
Grappling with feedback.

author: PC Gamer
text:
New changes to Windows 11 Start menu and search look genuinely exciting and thank the heavens that we'll be able to disable web results
Keep going in this direction, please, Microsoft.

author: PC Gamer
text:
So THIS is why component makers have started validating their products for Chinese memory
CXMT is estimated to essentially match Micron in terms of DRAM manufacturing capabilities this year.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'The company has turned its back on us': Black Flag Resynced developers at Ubisoft Barcelona are being laid off instead of celebrating the series' latest hit
"We will never see the fruits of our labour, and the reward for our hard work will be the loss of our jobs."

author: PC Gamer
text:
How to get Cryogenic Coolant in Palworld
Craft some upgrades with this icy material.

author: PC Gamer
text:
id Software producer says 'you'll never get another WoW or Morrowind in the current climate' in the wake of Xbox layoffs
"These large publishers and monopolies have proven themselves terrible stewards."

author: PC Gamer
text:
We might see a new Logitech Superstrike this September, just a few months after the world's first proper analogue mouse launched
Apparently no new sensor, though.

author: PC Gamer
text:
This is my 3rd time playing EVE Online's upcoming extraction shooter little brother, and it finally feels like it's coming together⁠—all without the ambitious crossover features it was made for
EVE Online is for nerds, EVE Vanguard is for the jocks.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Fallout: New Vegas director Josh Sawyer reveals his optimal outcome for the Mojave Wasteland
Independence all the way.
